national_baseline_notes: National baseline = 1.0 for cost_indices. Labor anchors: BLS OEWS May 2025 mean hourly wages (SOC 47-2111 Electricians, 49-9021 HVAC, 47-2152 Plumbers, 47-2181 Roofers, 49-2098 Electronic Equipment Installers as low-voltage proxy). Burdened shop rates ≈ BLS mean × 2.10–2.35 (fringes, WC, truck, overhead). ENR July 13 2026 20-city avg BCI = 8962.81; city BCI/avg clamped to 0.85–1.45 for residential remodel (raw ENR Dallas/Atlanta BCI ratios were <0.85). Permit USD = city permit fees only (not soft costs).
methodology: Batch 1 Top-30 MSAs for Quote Shield AI. (1) Labor: BLS Public API v2 OEWS May 2025 mean/median/p10/p90 per MSA CBSA; Bay Area = 60% San Francisco-Oakland + 40% San Jose blend. (2) Regional burden multipliers 2.10 (Sun Belt) – 2.35 (high-cost coastal). (3) Cost indices: ENR city BCI / 20-city avg when published (Jul 2026 PDF), else electrician wage-ratio proxy; material from ENR Materials Index or wage proxy; permit multiplier from electrical-panel fee mid / $108 national reference; all clamped 0.85–1.45. (4) Permits: BuildPermitGuide Oct 2026 research pages + PermitCalculator CSVs; E4 when primary city schedule not fetched. (5) ZIP3 = primary USPS 3-digit prefixes for MSA core. (6) Incentives = brief DSIRE / IRA HEAR / utility pointers — verify live before quoting.
